understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level and continue until the game is won, while completing levels efficiently.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions on the grid, while gravity is currently DOWN and can cause vertical falling. Clicking a tile can remove it or trigger movement/falling; clicks consume turns. Spike tiles are hazards that end the attempt on landing. Each level provides two attempts of up to 50 turns. Undo or restarting can recover from a failed attempt, with failures recorded in recent context.
